connector.name: Homespun
connector.registryDescription: Deploy a multi-user web app from your agent: hosting, auth, database, and permissions.
connector.summary: Hosted at homespun.dev over streamable HTTP, also runs locally from the npm package mcp. Needs an API key you supply, and it reaches all 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published under the verified namespace dev.homespun, which resolves to the same domain as the linked website. That pairing is the strongest ownership signal the registry exposes.
connector.authNote: A long lived key or token is required. Scope it as narrowly as the upstream service allows and rotate it on a schedule.

env.name: HOMESPUN_API_KEY
env.description: Homespun agent API key. If unset, the server auto-registers a fresh agent against the relay on first use and saves the key to the shared CLI store (~/.config/homespun/config.json).

env.name: HOMESPUN_URL
env.description: Homespun relay base URL. Defaults to the hosted relay https://homespun.dev; set this to point at a different relay.

env.name: HOMESPUN_AGENT_NAME
env.description: Display name for the auto-registered agent on the relay.

env.name: HOMESPUN_REGISTER_SECRET
env.description: Registration secret, required only for relays running REGISTRATION_MODE=secret.

recipes.cli: claude mcp add homespun --env HOMESPUN_API_KEY=<your-homespun-api-key> --env HOMESPUN_URL=<homespun-url> --env HOMESPUN_AGENT_NAME=<homespun-agent-name> --env HOMESPUN_REGISTER_SECRET=<your-homespun-register-secret> -- npx -y @homespunapps/mcp@1.6.41
